d1.text: D1: no query preview. 'scholar-harness run' goes from protocol through search, dedup, hydration and screening prep under one spinner (cli.py:826). The researcher never sees or approves the compiled query. Boards 2 and 3 add that gate.

d2.text: D2: one boolean string goes to every provider (protocol_adapter.py:64). Relevance engines do not honour boolean AND (UAV lesson 1). Board 2 shows a translation per provider.

d3.text: D3: the protocol's 'expected pool size' max becomes the per-query retrieval cap (protocol_adapter.py:74), and a capped count is reported like a complete one. Lesson 12: caps hide universes. Boards 4 and 5 flag cap-bound legs as lower bounds.

d4.text: D4: only the first protocol language is sent (protocol_adapter.py:71); the others are silently dropped. Board 2 shows this as a warning.

d5.text: D5: per-provider record counts are observed but not journaled. DISCOVERY_SEARCH stores provider names and how many succeeded, not records per database (discovery.py:505). PRISMA 2020 identification needs records per database. Board 5.

d6.text: D6: dedup writes no audit event (deduplication.py:9). In UAV v0.3 it merged 0 of 356 near-twin pairs (lesson 52) and it mutates representatives in place (lesson 15). Board 6 adds a near-twin review and a journal row.

d7.text: D7: each successful run overwrites raw_search.json and all_raw_search.json, which hold the same payload (discovery.py:413). Lesson 25: new file per run. Board 5 lists run-numbered files.

d8.text: D8: a recall check exists (scholar-search validate-query --seed) but is not part of the flow. Inception's anchor DOIs are ready-made seeds. Board 3.

d9.text: D9 (strength): honest SUCCESS / PARTIAL / EMPTY_RESULT / FAILED status, fail-closed publication and stale-artifact disclosure (discovery.py:216). The wireframes surface these instead of hiding them in the journal.

d10.text: D10: provider precision differs ~70x (lesson 44); Crossref runs without a type filter (lesson 46); per-query yield is not computed during the harvest (lesson 49). Boards 4 and 5 show per-provider and per-query yield.

d11.text: D11: default providers omit PubMed; Scopus and Web of Science are unsupported; MCP nexus_discover hardcodes 4 providers. Board 2 makes the database list explicit and shows what is not covered.
